caption: The video captures a man in a black sleeveless shirt with a pink-and-yellow logo, black trousers and multicoloured sneakers dancing in a studio whose mirror wall, ballet barre and round clock frame a wooden floor. Back to the camera, he extends his arms sideways, then rotates into a side profile, bending his arms in front as one foot lifts. Facing the camera, he opens his arms wide and glances left, then turns to a crossed-arm profile and returns to a back-to-camera stance with arms out. His arms draw toward his chest, rest on his hips, and drop to his sides, after which he holds a wide-legged posture with slight sway. He lifts his arms outward into a broad horizontal pose, then bends them toward his front. The mirror shows his front when he faces it and his back when he turns away. Reflected participants in teal, purple and yellow stay largely in place. The camera remains largely fixed.
